title: Introduction to generalised Cesaro convergence II
summary: In this second of three introductory papers, we extend the notion of generalised Cesaro summation/convergence to the more natural setting of what we call remainder Cesaro summation/convergence. This greatly expands the range of problems susceptible to Cesaro methods and introduces the geometric location of summands as a critical consideration. We also show that geometric generalised Cesaro convergence is invariant under dilation and scaling. We present a number of calculations illustrating the utility of these developments.
